task.description:
Implement SCH-03 (Timer cancellation) so pending timers are cancelled atomically when an instance is cancelled (EE-08) or completed.

Read SCH-03 acceptance criteria in docs/BPM_Platform_Functional_Requirements.md and follow scheduler design boundaries in src/design/scheduler.md before editing code.

Implementation requirements:
- In the same transaction that records instance cancellation/completion state and event, set all matching timers with status = PENDING to status = CANCELLED for the instance.
- Ensure SCH-02 polling does not fire timers that were cancelled by SCH-03.
- Preserve race behavior: if scheduler has already locked/fired a timer, first transaction to commit wins and the other rolls back.
- Keep already FIRED timers unchanged.
- Keep transition function purity contract (no I/O in src/engine/transition.zig).

Validation requirements:
- zig build exits 0
- zig build test exits 0
- zig build migrate exits 0
acceptance_criteria: All PENDING timers are set to CANCELLED in the same transaction as instance cancellation/completion
No CANCELLED-instance timer remains PENDING after commit
Scheduler polling does not fire CANCELLED timers
Concurrent cancel-vs-fire behavior matches SCH-03 first-commit-wins rule

result.summary: Implemented SCH-03 terminal-state timer cancellation by cancelling all PENDING timers in the same transaction when instance transitions to COMPLETED/CANCELLED in transition persistence paths, and added integration coverage proving completion-triggered cancellation prevents scheduler firing.
